description: React (Vite) merchant dashboard + polish + README + .env.example (build-priority items 9 UI, 12). Builds the polished dashboard UI consuming the API, the customer detail page with explainability and review/appeal controls, and finishes documentation. Depends on FEAT-003 (API).
steps: Create web/ workspace: Vite + React + TypeScript. package.json, tsconfig, vite config with a dev proxy so /api -> backend (PORT). Install react, react-dom, vite, typescript, @types.

Dashboard page: total subscription revenue, recovered revenue, revenue at risk, pending recovery, lost revenue, recovery rate, customer risk distribution (low/medium/high), restricted/suspended accounts, recent recovery events. Clean, readable layout (cards + simple charts/bars, no heavy chart lib required).

Customer list + Customer detail page: subscription info, payment history, behavioural timeline, Trust/Risk score with band, evidence list (the explainable reasons), recommended recovery action + expected outcome, current access state, and review/appeal controls (approve blacklist recommendation, reinstate/restore access) wired to POST /api/customers/:id/review. An 'Explain' button calls /explain to show the LLM-or-fallback narrative + drafted recovery message.

Make the demo obviously show RECOVER vs RESTRICT/SUSPEND: color-code outcome/state, and clearly surface that scenario 7 is a legitimate repeated-failure RECOVER (not blacklist) vs scenario 6 SUSPEND + blacklist-recommended.

Add root README.md: product summary (accurate, no overstated AI/ML/Razorpay claims), architecture overview (modules: domain, engine, adapters, db, api, web), setup (npm install, .env from .env.example, npm run seed, npm run dev for server + web), required env vars table, WHERE to put OPENROUTER_API_KEY (in .env), how the deterministic demo mode works with no key, Razorpay simulation/test mode + webhook verification note, demo walkthrough of the 7 scenarios, running tests, and Known Limitations.

Add .env.example at repo root with OPENROUTER_API_KEY=PASTE_YOUR_OPENROUTER_API_KEY_HERE, OPENROUTER_MODEL=..., OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, RAZORPAY_KEY_ID, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, RAZORPAY_MODE=simulation, PORT, DATABASE_PATH. Confirm .gitignore excludes .env and *.db.
Add convenient root scripts (e.g. `npm run dev` running server, `npm run dev:web`, and a `build` that builds both workspaces).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` builds BOTH server (tsc) and web (vite build) with no errors
web dev server renders the dashboard and customer detail against the running API
README documents setup, env vars, architecture, demo instructions, where to put the OpenRouter key, and limitations, with no overstated claims
.env.example present with all required vars incl. the OPENROUTER_API_KEY placeholder; .env and *.db are gitignored
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm both workspaces build
Start server (seeded) + web dev server and load the dashboard + a customer detail page to confirm data renders and review controls call the API
Confirm `git status` shows no .env or .db files would be tracked
